causal_structure.derived_order: x<y iff a directed path from x to y exists
causal_structure.equivalence: directed-graph isomorphism together with unitary edge-space identifications

edge_systems.assignment: each directed edge e carries a finite-dimensional complex Hilbert space H_e

vertex_processes.assignment: each vertex x carries a CPTP map E_x from density operators on the tensor product of incoming edge spaces to density operators on the tensor product of outgoing edge spaces
vertex_processes.source_vertex_rule: a source vertex prepares a density operator on its outgoing edge spaces
vertex_processes.sink_vertex_rule: a sink vertex maps its incoming state to the trivial one-dimensional output
vertex_processes.composition: contract matching edge input/output systems in any topological order
vertex_processes.composition_certificate: finite-dimensional CPTP maps remain CPTP under sequential and tensor composition

states.input: a positive semidefinite trace-one operator on all declared input-boundary edge spaces
states.output: the density operator produced by composing all vertex processes
states.internal_observables: defined only through a declared quantum instrument inserted at the measured vertex
states.boundary_observables: Hermitian operators or POVMs on declared boundary tensor factors

finite_sector.probability_rule: Born probabilities computed from the composed finite CPTP process and declared POVM
finite_sector.label_invariance: all physical outputs are compared after the graph isomorphism and associated unitary edge-space maps

undefined_components: class of graph isomorphism sectors in the infinite-cutoff limit
measure dmu_G over channels and states
physical inner product across graph sectors

operator_basis.definition: fixed weighted counts of order intervals by cardinality
a preregistered Benincasa-Dowker-type finite interval combination in a declared dimension estimator
operator_basis.warning: The target dimension may not be selected after observing the result.

operator_basis.definition: fixed low spectral moments normalized by event count
a preregistered finite-dimensional coherent-information bound or explicitly named proxy

required_interface: map from fine graph/process to coarse graph/process
preservation or controlled violation of CPTP structure
